title.es: Ollama v0.40.17 soporta Inkling 2 Mini y ejecución concurrente en Apple silicon
title.en: Ollama v0.40.17 supports Inkling 2 Mini and concurrent execution on Apple silicon

body.es: Ollama ha lanzado la versión 0.40.17, que añade soporte para el modelo Inkling 2 Mini de Thinking Machines, un modelo de 26B parámetros que ocupa unos 20 GB y obtiene un 79,2 % en SWE-Bench Verified. La actualización también permite a Ollama en Apple silicon servir múltiples solicitudes simultáneamente y corrige fallos de carga en GPUs integradas mediante el uso de mmap en Vulkan. Esto permite a los desarrolladores ejecutar modelos de IA más grandes y complejos localmente en Macs con Apple silicon, mejorando el rendimiento y la fiabilidad.
body.en: Ollama has released version 0.40.17, which adds support for Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini model, a 26B parameter model that takes up about 20 GB and scores 79.2% on SWE-Bench Verified. The update also allows Ollama on Apple silicon to serve multiple requests at once and fixes load failures on integrated GPUs by using mmap in Vulkan. This allows developers to run larger and more complex AI models locally on Macs with Apple silicon, improving performance and reliability.

evidence.claim: Ollama release v0.40.17 supports the Inkling 2 Mini model.
The Inkling 2 Mini model scores 79.2% on SWE-Bench.
Ollama launch claude supports deferred tool loading.
Ollama on Apple silicon now serves multiple requests at once.
Vulkan now uses mmap for integrated GPUs, fixing load failures on shared-memory GPUs.

title.es: Cloudflare WAF bloquea ruby2shell para todos sus clientes
title.en: Cloudflare WAF blocks ruby2shell for all its customers

body.es: Cloudflare ha activado el bloqueo de la vulnerabilidad ruby2shell (CVE-2026-132825) en su WAF para todos los clientes, incluidos los del plan gratuito. La vulnerabilidad afecta a aplicaciones Ruby, incluyendo Ruby on Rails y Sinatra, y ha sido corregida en Ruby 3.3.14, 3.4.13 y 4.0.10. Los administradores de servidores que ejecutan aplicaciones Ruby deben actualizar sus sistemas para mitigar el riesgo, ya que la vulnerabilidad puede ser explotada antes de la autenticación.
body.en: Cloudflare has enabled blocking for the ruby2shell vulnerability (CVE-2026-132825) in its WAF for all customers, including those on the Free plan. The vulnerability affects Ruby applications, including Ruby on Rails and Sinatra, and has been fixed in Ruby 3.3.14, 3.4.13, and 4.0.10. Server administrators running Ruby applications should update their systems to mitigate the risk, as the vulnerability can be exploited before authentication.

evidence.claim: Cloudflare WAF blocks ruby2shell for all customers, including those on the Free plan.

The reach is wide, with self-hosted products that bundle Ruby, including GitLab, GitHub Enterprise Server, Mastodon, OpenProject, Discourse and Chatwoot, shipped an affected Ruby in their latest release at the time of disclosure.
Ruby 3.3.14, 3.4.13, and 4.0.10 fix the ruby2shell vulnerability.
Cloudflare has patched its systems that use Ruby against ruby2shell.
Veria Labs reports that Ruby on Rails and classic-style Sinatra applications reach the bug in their default configuration, before any authentication.

title.es: JetBrains alerta sobre vulnerabilidad crítica en Java que afecta a YouTrack Server
title.en: JetBrains alerts on critical Java vulnerability affecting YouTrack Server

body.es: JetBrains ha emitido una alerta de seguridad para YouTrack Server debido a una vulnerabilidad crítica en Java, identificada como CVE-2026-114938 o Java4Shell. La vulnerabilidad afecta a los runtimes de Java utilizados por muchas aplicaciones, incluyendo YouTrack Server, y requiere que los administradores actualicen sus sistemas para mitigar el riesgo. La divulgación pública de la vulnerabilidad tuvo lugar el 17 de noviembre de 2026.
body.en: JetBrains has issued a security alert for YouTrack Server due to a critical vulnerability in Java, identified as CVE-2026-114938 or Java4Shell. The vulnerability affects Java runtimes used by many applications, including YouTrack Server, and requires administrators to update their systems to mitigate the risk. The public disclosure of the vulnerability took place on November 17, 2026.

evidence.claim: A critical vulnerability in Java was publicly disclosed on November 17, 2026, with the CVE identifier CVE-2026-114938.
The vulnerability affects Java runtimes used by many applications, including YouTrack Server.
YouTrack Server administrators are required to update their systems to mitigate the vulnerability.

title.es: Agentes de IA explotaron una vulnerabilidad 0-day en una aplicación de imagen médica
title.en: AI agents exploited a 0-day vulnerability in a medical imaging application

body.es: Según el CISO de Amazon, CJ Moses, atacantes vinculados a China utilizaron agentes de IA para encontrar y explotar de forma autónoma una vulnerabilidad 0-day en MONAI Label, una aplicación de imagen médica de código abierto. Los agentes adaptaron su estrategia durante casi un día sin dirección humana, logrando el control total de un servidor en una red universitaria. Este incidente destaca el creciente uso de agentes de IA en operaciones de espionaje y ciberdelincuencia.
body.en: According to Amazon CISO CJ Moses, China-linked attackers used AI agents to autonomously find and exploit a 0-day vulnerability in MONAI Label, an open-source medical imaging application. The agents adapted their strategy for nearly a day without human direction, gaining full control of a server in a university network. This incident highlights the growing use of AI agents in espionage and cybercrime operations.

evidence.claim: China-linked attackers used AI agents to autonomously find and exploit a zero-day vulnerability in an open-source application.
The AI agents adapted autonomously for nearly a full day without human direction.
The AI agents found and exploited a zero-day vulnerability in MONAI Label, an open-source medical imaging AI application.
The attackers used the AI agents to target university networks in East Asia, outside Mainland China.
The attackers also used the AI agents to target other companies, including a Fortune 500 hospitality company and a major US airline.

title.es: Apple documenta límites de uso de Apple Intelligence por nivel de iCloud+
title.en: Apple documents usage limits for Apple Intelligence by iCloud+ tier

body.es: Apple ha documentado que las funciones de Apple Intelligence y Siri AI tienen límites de uso diarios, que pueden aumentarse actualizando el plan de iCloud+. Los límites se reinician alrededor de la medianoche en la zona horaria del usuario, con excepciones para viajes internacionales y grupos de Family Sharing. Esta medida busca garantizar una experiencia de alta calidad y fiable para todos los usuarios.
body.en: Apple has documented that Apple Intelligence and Siri AI features have daily usage limits, which can be increased by upgrading the iCloud+ plan. The limits reset around midnight in the user's time zone, with exceptions for international travel and Family Sharing groups. This measure aims to ensure a high-quality, reliable experience for all users.

evidence.claim: Apple Intelligence and Siri AI features have daily usage limits.
Users can upgrade their iCloud+ plan to increase their daily usage limits for Apple Intelligence and Siri AI features.
The Siri AI limit in the 2027 software releases is more capable, conversational, and personal.
Users will be notified when they hit their daily usage limit for a particular feature category.
The daily usage limit resets around midnight in the user's current time zone.

title.es: Filtrado sugiere más widgets en la pantalla de bloqueo del iPhone Duo
title.en: Leak suggests more widgets on the iPhone Duo Lock Screen

body.es: Un filtrado sugiere que Apple ha probado una 'columna de complicaciones' para la pantalla de bloqueo del iPhone Duo, que permite colocar dos widgets circulares en el borde derecho. Esta disposición puede usarse junto con la fila inferior existente, dando a los usuarios acceso a más información. La función aún no está disponible y podría no llegar a todos los usuarios.
body.en: A leak suggests that Apple has tested a 'complication column' for the iPhone Duo Lock Screen, which allows placing two circular widgets on the right edge. This arrangement can be used together with the existing bottom row, giving users access to more information. The feature is not yet available and may not reach all users.

evidence.claim: Apple has tested a 'complication column' for iPhone Duo's Lock Screen.
The 'complication column' can be used together with the existing bottom row.

title.es: METR actualiza su gráfico de horizonte temporal de IA
title.en: METR updates its AI time horizon plot

body.es: METR ha actualizado su gráfico de horizonte temporal de IA, añadiendo tareas más largas y abiertas para evaluar la capacidad de los modelos. La actualización refleja el avance de los sistemas de IA en codificación y matemáticas, dos dominios donde es posible determinar automáticamente si una solución funciona o no. Sin embargo, ninguna de las evaluaciones diseñadas por IA fue considerada útil por los empleados de METR para su investigación.
body.en: METR has updated its AI time horizon plot, adding longer and more open-ended tasks to evaluate model capabilities. The update reflects the progress of AI systems in coding and math, two domains where it is possible to automatically determine whether a solution works or not. However, none of the AI-designed evaluations were considered useful by METR employees for their research.

evidence.claim: METR evaluated models by having them attempt a large suite of tasks, each of which had also been completed by humans.
The updated plot adds more tasks—some that are estimated to take humans far longer than those in the original suite, and others that are more open-ended.
AI systems have become so good at coding and math, two domains where it’s possible to determine automatically whether a solution does or doesn’t work.
Not one of the AI-designed evaluations was good enough for METR employees to consider it useful for their research.

METR’s time horizon plots score task difficulty by evaluating how long it would take a human to complete the task, and for the original plot they measured this quantity by actually having people try each task.

title.es: Una semana con los nuevos controles de privacidad en MacOS 27.3 Beta 2
title.en: A Week With the New Privacy Controls in MacOS 27.3 Beta 2

text.es: Los nuevos controles de privacidad de MacOS 27.3 Beta 2 están diseñados para ser más fáciles de usar y proporcionar información más clara sobre los permisos. Sin embargo, algunos usuarios encuentran distrayente el indicador de barra de menú que aparece cuando una aplicación controla a otra, que no puede desactivarse.
text.en: The new privacy controls in MacOS 27.3 Beta 2 are designed to be more user-friendly and provide clearer information about permissions. However, some users find the menu bar indicator that appears when one app is controlling another distracting, as it cannot be turned off.

evidence.claim: The new privacy controls are designed to be more user-friendly and provide clearer information about permissions.
The new privacy controls are intended to discourage users from granting Full Disk Access to certain applications.
There is a menu bar indicator for apps controlling other apps, which cannot be turned off and is considered distracting by some users.

title.es: El fracaso de monetización de la búsqueda con IA de Google está costando ingresos a Apple
title.en: Google's AI search monetization failure is costing Apple revenue

text.es: La división de Servicios de Apple está viendo cómo su crecimiento se frena del 12 % al 10 % interanual, en parte debido a la incapacidad de Google para monetizar la búsqueda con IA al mismo nivel que la búsqueda tradicional. Las acciones de Google han caído un 18 % desde que informó de un descenso en el crecimiento de los ingresos por publicidad de búsqueda.
text.en: Apple's Services arm is seeing its growth slow from 12% to 10% year-over-year, partly due to Google's inability to monetize AI search to the same level as traditional search. Google's shares have dropped 18% since it reported a downturn in search advertising revenue growth.

evidence.claim: Apple's Services arm is slowing growth from 12% to 10% year-over-year.
Google's ad monetization for searches in AI mode was lower than for traditional searches.
Google's shares dropped 18% since it reported a downturn in search advertising revenue growth.
Google is struggling to monetize the increased popularity of AI search results.

title.es: Gurman: Los despidos en Siri ahorraron los nuevos sistemas de IA, pero los problemas persisten
title.en: Gurman: Siri Layoffs Spared Newer AI Systems, But Problems Persist

text.es: Según Mark Gurman de Bloomberg, los recientes despidos en Siri afectaron a empleados que trabajaban en la infraestructura más antigua del asistente, no en sus nuevos sistemas de IA. Apple enfrenta una creciente competencia de desarrolladores de IA que actualizan sus modelos y servicios con mucha más frecuencia que el ciclo anual de sistemas operativos de Apple.
text.en: According to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Apple's recent Siri layoffs affected employees working on the assistant's older infrastructure, not its newer AI systems. Apple faces growing competition from AI developers that update their models and services far more frequently than Apple's annual operating system cycle.

evidence.claim: Apple's recent Siri layoffs affected employees working on the assistant's older infrastructure rather than its newer AI systems.
Apple's internal release calendar for major operating system updates is largely determined by late summer or early fall of the preceding year.
Apple faces growing competition from AI developers that update their models and services far more frequently than Apple's annual operating system cycle.

title.es: Los bancos están harto de tu agente de IA
title.en: Banks Have Had It Up to Here With Your AI Agent

text.es: Las principales instituciones financieras de EE. UU. están prohibiendo a los bots de terceros iniciar sesión en sus cuentas y advirtiendo que cualquier error costoso del bot es estrictamente responsabilidad del usuario. Esta medida busca proteger la seguridad de las cuentas y evitar el uso no autorizado de agentes de IA.
text.en: Major US financial institutions are banning third-party bots from logging into their accounts and warning that any costly bot mistakes are strictly the user's responsibility. This measure aims to protect account security and prevent unauthorized use of AI agents.

evidence.claim: Major US financial institutions are banning third-party bots from logging into your accounts.

why_it_matters.es: REA permite a los desarrolladores usar agentes de IA para ingeniería inversa de aplicaciones y binarios, facilitando la comprensión de cómo funcionan las funciones de una aplicación a nivel de binario.
why_it_matters.en: REA allows developers to use AI agents to reverse engineer applications and binaries, making it easier to understand how an app's features work at the binary level.

why_it_matters.en: MROffice provides open-source editors for documents, spreadsheets, and presentations that can be embedded in web apps or used from AI apps via MCP, offering a free alternative to Microsoft Office.

trending_repos.name: hermes-agent
trending_repos.description: The agent that grows with you

why_it_matters.es: Hermes Agent es un agente de IA auto-mejorable que crea habilidades a partir de la experiencia, mejora durante el uso y construye un modelo profundo del usuario a lo largo de las sesiones, permitiendo su ejecución en infraestructuras de bajo costo.
why_it_matters.en: Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI agent that creates skills from experience, improves during use, and builds a deep model of the user across sessions, allowing it to run on low-cost infrastructure.

trending_repos.name: PiBot
trending_repos.description: Open-source, local-first AI agent team for your desktop: multi-agent group chats, computer use, browser, MCP, routines and approvals. macOS, Windows, Linux + Android. Built on pi.

why_it_matters.es: PiBot es un equipo de agentes de IA de código abierto y local-first para el escritorio, que permite a los bots planificar, ejecutar comandos, editar archivos y navegar por la web, con aprobaciones para cada paso arriesgado.
why_it_matters.en: PiBot is an open-source, local-first AI agent team for the desktop, allowing bots to plan, run commands, edit files, and browse the web, with approvals for every risky step.
